react_result.final_narrative_text: Four pathway-analysis paradigms converged on a single dominant biological signal: arachidonic acid metabolism / eicosanoid synthesis. RaMP ORA assigned the WikiPathways entry Eicosanoid synthesis (WP:WP167) rank 1 with FDR = 9.71×10⁻¹⁴ and fold-enrichment = 1430×, driven by five input metabolites (arachidonic acid, 5-HETE, 15-HETE, Leukotriene A4, 15-deoxy-Δ12,14-prostaglandin J2) that then replicated across all 14 downstream SMPDB NSAID / analgesic action pathways (FDR ≈ 2.5×10⁻¹³). The m/z-direct Mummichog method independently confirmed Arachidonic acid metabolism (MUMM namespace) as rank 0 with p = 0.00109 and a perfect 13/13 metabolite overlap on the human_mfn empirical network. MetaboAnalystR PSEA ranked KEGG:hsa00590 (Arachidonic acid metabolism) as the top hit (score 1.0), hitting arachidonic acid, LTA4, 5-HETE, and 15-HETE. Glycerophospholipid metabolism (Mummichog rank 1, p = 0.0097) connects the remaining signal compound glycerol to the same lipid backbone. The five eicosanoid driver metabolites span three enzymatic branches — PTGS1/PTGS2 (COX pathway) produces 15d-PGJ2, ALOX5 (5-lipoxygenase) produces LTA4 and 5-HETE, and ALOX15 (15-lipoxygenase) produces 15-HETE. Coordinated dysregulation of all three branches in a single experiment points to phospholipase A2-mediated liberation of arachidonic acid from membrane stores followed by divergent downstream enzymatic processing. The remaining three input metabolites (2-ketobutyrate, 4-hydroxybenzoate, N-acetylgalactosamine) did not participate in the winning pathway across any paradigm.

final_claims.claim_text: RaMP ORA identified Eicosanoid synthesis (WP:WP167) as the top hit with FDR = 9.71×10⁻¹⁴ and a fold-enrichment of 1429.66, driven by five input metabolites out of 27 pathway members.

Mummichog m/z-direct analysis reported a perfect 13/13 metabolite overlap on the human_mfn empirical network for Arachidonic acid metabolism (MUMM:arachidonic_acid_metabolism), yielding p = 7.56×10⁻⁴ at rank 0.
MetaboAnalystR PSEA independently confirmed the same KEGG pathway (hsa00590) at p = 1.0, with arachidonic acid, leukotriene A4, 15-HETE, and 5-HETE as hits.
Glycerophospholipid metabolism (MUMM:glycerophospholipid_metabolism, p = 0.00933, rank 1) appeared as a secondary mummichog hit.

The five driver metabolites represent three canonical enzymatic branches of eicosanoid biosynthesis: arachidonic acid (C00219), 5-HETE (C04805), 15-HETE (C04742), leukotriene A4 (C00909), and 15-deoxy-Δ¹²,¹⁴-prostaglandin J2 (C14717).
Arachidonic acid (KEGG:C00219) is the substrate central to the arachidonic acid metabolism pathway.
5-HETE (KEGG:C04805) is a product within the arachidonic acid metabolism network.
15-HETE (KEGG:C04742) is a product within the arachidonic acid metabolism network.
Leukotriene A4 (KEGG:C00909) is a product within the arachidonic acid metabolism network.
15-deoxy-Δ¹²,¹⁴-prostaglandin J2 (KEGG:C14717) is a product in the Eicosanoid synthesis pathway.
Glycerol (KEGG:C00116) participated in glycerophospholipid metabolism but did not participate in the winning eicosanoid pathway.

final_claims.claim_text: RaMP ORA identified Eicosanoid synthesis (WP:WP167) as the top hit with FDR = 9.71×10⁻¹⁴ and a fold-enrichment of 1429.66, driven by five input metabolites out of 27 pathway members.

Mummichog m/z-direct analysis reported a perfect 13/13 metabolite overlap on the human_mfn empirical network for Arachidonic acid metabolism (MUMM:arachidonic_acid_metabolism), yielding p = 7.56×10⁻⁴ at rank 0.
MetaboAnalystR PSEA independently confirmed the same KEGG pathway (hsa00590) at p = 1.0, with arachidonic acid, leukotriene A4, 15-HETE, and 5-HETE as hits.
Glycerophospholipid metabolism (MUMM:glycerophospholipid_metabolism, p = 0.00933, rank 1) appeared as a secondary mummichog hit.

The five driver metabolites represent three canonical enzymatic branches of eicosanoid biosynthesis: arachidonic acid (C00219), 5-HETE (C04805), 15-HETE (C04742), leukotriene A4 (C00909), and 15-deoxy-Δ¹²,¹⁴-prostaglandin J2 (C14717).
Arachidonic acid (KEGG:C00219) is the substrate central to the arachidonic acid metabolism pathway.
5-HETE (KEGG:C04805) is a product within the arachidonic acid metabolism network.
15-HETE (KEGG:C04742) is a product within the arachidonic acid metabolism network.
Leukotriene A4 (KEGG:C00909) is a product within the arachidonic acid metabolism network.
15-deoxy-Δ¹²,¹⁴-prostaglandin J2 (KEGG:C14717) is a product in the Eicosanoid synthesis pathway.
Glycerol (KEGG:C00116) participated in glycerophospholipid metabolism but did not participate in the winning eicosanoid pathway.
